presentationRow.displayName: Invariant anticanonical indices and conversion of twisted differentials

claim.ja: 自然トーラス作用の不変反標準Euler指数は可除指数上で多項式となり実際の零次値を保つ。別に、smoothly semipositiveな−K_Sの無限twistsから固定擬有効誤差を除き、正冪の通常切断を得る。
claim.en: The naturally linearized invariant anticanonical Euler index is polynomial on divisible exponents with its actual value at zero. Independently, smooth semipositivity removes a fixed pseudoeffective error from unbounded twists to produce an ordinary positive-power section.

role.ja: 局所化・削除面の相殺と、有界底計量・零次も含む消滅という独立な二経路を接続する。不変形式を有限被覆へ先に降下し、その後で通常のconversionを使う。
role.en: Connects independent localization/deleted-face and bounded-metric/vanishing arguments. Invariant forms descend to the finite cover before ordinary conversion is applied.

connections.role: Supplies finite cover with residual torus and deck-invariant canonical frames for invariant-form descent
connections.hypotheses: Smooth connected projective X with smoothly semipositive anticanonical line. The compact residual factor has no positive-degree forms, so I_T(0)=1.
